title: The Baseline Project
description: This pack is a Fabric pack to connect to Vanilla servers that gives just some quality of life bits
body:
# The Baseline Project


The Baseline Project is a lightweight, performance-focused Fabric modpack built for players who love the classic, unmodded feel of Minecraft but want a few essential quality-of-life enhancements.

This pack keeps the core gameplay exactly the same meaning no game-breaking mechanics or heavy modifications giving you a smooth "Vanilla-Plus" base that is 100% compatible with standard Vanilla and Fabric-based multiplayer servers giving just a few small tweeks.


## ✨ Key Features
Vanilla Server Support: Join any vanilla or modified multiplayer server seamlessly without causing conflicts or connection errors.

Essential HUD & Information: Get helpful, non-intrusive details about the world around you right on your screen.

Stunning Visuals & Performance: Full shader support alongside client-side optimizations to make your game look beautiful and run flawlessly.

Purely Client-Side: Everything runs entirely on your own computer, so you don't need to change anything on a server to use it.




## 📦 Featured Mods Included

- [3D Skin Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers)
- [Better Advancements](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-advancements)
- [Blue Netherite](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/blue-netherite)
- [Chat Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/chat-heads)
- [Client Sort](https://modrinth.com/mod/clientsort)
- [Dark Interface](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/dark-interface)
- [Freecam](https://modrinth.com/mod/freecam)
- [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)
- [Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade)
- [Lighty](https://modrinth.com/mod/lighty)
- [Locator Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/locator-heads)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
- [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks)
- [Peak](https://modrinth.com/mod/peek)
- [Xearo's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap)
- [Xearo's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map)


### Disclamer 

Not all mods are allowed on every server, so make sure to read the server rules before using them.
